title: Gerchsheimer tricks Schauberger into signing over IP

tellings.quote: Gerchsheimer then tricks Schauberger into signing all of his IP over to the US which gets branded as atomic energy research.

plain: In 1957 a man named Carl Gerchsheimer is said to have tricked the Austrian inventor Viktor Schauberger into signing all his inventions and ideas over to the United States, after which they were labeled atomic energy research. Michels tells this himself, naming the writer Nick Cook among his sources, in a documentary about Townsend Brown, a scientist he says built UFOs for the CIA. If true, it would mean the US quietly took over an inventor's work and hid it under another name.
